name: DeepSeek R1
description: Open-source reasoning model rivaling OpenAI o1 at a fraction of the cost.
longDescription: DeepSeek R1 is a groundbreaking open-source reasoning model that matches or exceeds OpenAI o1 on math, code, and reasoning benchmarks. It uses reinforcement learning to develop chain-of-thought reasoning, and its open weights make it accessible for self-hosting.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.deepseek.com/v1",
    api_key="YOUR_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-reasoner",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Solve: What is 27^(1/3) + 15?"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
